_about: The surveyed ground and the aerial photograph of each range, fetched by scripts/terrain/fetch.mjs on GitHub's runner (the Terrain workflow) from two US government services, public domain. Each file is named with its content hash and served under /terrain/ with a one-year cache header. Heights are 16-bit PNGs: metres above sea level = pixel × stepM + offsetM, the top-left pixel's centre at (originE + spacingM/2, originN − spacingM/2) in NAD83 / UTM zone 11N (EPSG 26911), rows running south. The photograph covers the same square as the near heights. Every figure here is a reading of the service's own answer on the date given.

surfaces._about: The photographed ground surfaces (range-day-eight): CC0 material scans from Poly Haven and ambientCG, fetched once by scripts/ground/fetch.mjs on GitHub's runner (the Ground workflow, run linked in each record) onto the scratch branch range-day-eight-fetch, where every candidate stays with its own record (ground-fetch/manifest.json). One material per surface was chosen in the session and prepared there: resized with Lanczos, saved as JPEG, a colour picture and a relief picture (red and green: the scan's OpenGL normal map, x east and y north; blue: its height map), named with the content hash and served under /terrain/ with a one-year cache header. Full uses the 1,024-pixel set, Light the 512-pixel set. license is the library's license page's own sentences as the run fetched them.

floor.why: Pale packed dirt with clods, crumbs and scattered small stones over a cracked crust, lit flat: the closest to the photographs' 'pale tan packed dirt' and the spotting scope's 'clods and crumbs with hard small shadows'. Not chosen: dirt and dry_mud_field_001 (dark wet-looking mud), dirt_aerial_03 and aerial_ground_rock (drone captures whose metre-wide stains would repeat recognisably), Ground111 (red bands), Ground110 (dark gravel).
